open_items: operator: Shaked gave "JobRun" (2026-11-21). A policy names who legally answers to the users: if JobRun is registered, print its registered name and number; if not, add the founders' names (JR-L01)
minimum age is 18 (Shaked, 2026-11-21) and section 12 says so; the sign-up screen does not state it yet (JR-L33)
Supabase project region: section 6 says Europe and the United States; confirm where the database and files are kept (JR-L18)
OpenAI account data controls: confirm the retention and training settings of the account before relying on section 5 (JR-L17, JR-L29)
Vercel code runner: what it keeps of a run and for how long (JR-L17)
the old copies of the site: on 2026-11-21 Netlify answered 404 and the Render server did not answer; whoever holds those accounts confirms they are deleted, otherwise name them in section 5 (JR-L17)
closing an account is done by hand today: agree who handles a request and run one test request end to end (JR-L11, JR-L12)
the pilot list holds a first name the founders typed for each invited member; section 2 does not list it: remove the names or add the line (JR-L07)
an Israeli lawyer reads both language versions before status becomes published (the legal report, section 1)

text.he: אני מאשר/ת שהאתר יאסוף וישמור את התשובות שלי, ההערכות שהן מקבלות ונתוני התרגול שלי, וישתמש בהם כדי להתאים לי אישית את תוכנית ההכנה, השאלות והמשוב. קראתי את מדיניות הפרטיות.
text.en: I agree that the site may collect and keep my answers, the evaluations they receive and my practice data, and use them to adapt the preparation plan, the questions and the feedback to me personally. I have read the privacy policy.
